author: Zintenka
body:
Our contest map with tnt of course. Holograms are going to be in usage. 


But yeah, looks good doesn't it?

Authors:
  • Zintenka
  • TheHoopsman
  • Slvrflash

Features:
  • TNT
  • Holograms
  • XP bottles for a iron mined
  • Every kill gives you 8 additional TNT and a dispenser.
  • No building in the void. The kit has feather falling 127 for Icarus player launchers to PVP on the enemy side.
